Accident.name: Accident Severity
Accident.description: The severity of an accident involving the insured vehicle.

states_description.Mild: A minor accident with minimal impact.
states_description.Moderate: A moderate accident with notable damage or injury.
states_description.Severe: A serious accident with significant damage or injury.

Age.name: Driver Age Group
Age.description: The age category of the primary driver.

states_description.Adolescent: Young or teen driver, typically under 25.

Airbag.name: Airbag Present
Airbag.description: Whether the vehicle is equipped with airbags.

states_description.False: The vehicle does not have airbags.

AntiTheft.name: Anti-Theft Device
AntiTheft.description: Whether the vehicle is equipped with an anti-theft system.

states_description.True: The vehicle has an anti-theft device installed.
states_description.False: The vehicle does not have an anti-theft device.

Antilock.name: Antilock Brakes
Antilock.description: Whether the vehicle is equipped with antilock braking system (ABS).

states_description.False: The vehicle does not have antilock brakes.

CarValue.name: Car Value
CarValue.description: The estimated market value of the insured vehicle.

Cushioning.name: Cushioning Quality
Cushioning.description: The quality of the vehicle's occupant cushioning and crash protection systems.

states_description.Poor: Minimal occupant protection in a collision.

DrivHist.name: Driving History
DrivHist.description: The number of previous accidents or violations on the driver's record.

DrivQuality.name: Driving Quality
DrivQuality.description: An overall assessment of the driver's on-road driving behavior.

states_description.Poor: Frequently unsafe or reckless driving behavior.
states_description.Excellent: Highly safe and attentive driving behavior.

DrivingSkill.name: Driving Skill
DrivingSkill.description: The inherent driving skill level of the driver.

GoodStudent.name: Good Student
GoodStudent.description: Whether the driver qualifies for a good student discount, indicating academic achievement.

states_description.True: The driver qualifies as a good student.
states_description.False: The driver does not qualify as a good student.

HomeBase.name: Home Base Location
HomeBase.description: The type of area where the vehicle is primarily garaged or parked.

states_description.Secure: Vehicle is kept in a secure, protected location such as a locked garage.
states_description.City: Vehicle is primarily kept in an urban city environment.
states_description.Suburb: Vehicle is primarily kept in a suburban area.
states_description.Rural: Vehicle is primarily kept in a rural area.

ILiCost.name: Injury Liability Cost
ILiCost.description: The estimated cost of injury liability claims resulting from an accident.

states_description.Million: Injury liability cost around $1,000,000 or more.

MakeModel.name: Vehicle Make and Model Category
MakeModel.description: The general category of the vehicle's make and model.

MedCost.name: Medical Cost
MedCost.description: The estimated medical costs resulting from an accident.

Mileage.name: Annual Mileage
Mileage.description: The estimated number of miles driven per year.

states_description.Domino: Extremely high mileage, well above 50,000 miles per year.

OtherCar.name: Other Car Involved
OtherCar.description: Whether another car was involved in the accident.

states_description.True: Another car was involved in the accident.
states_description.False: No other car was involved in the accident.

OtherCarCost.name: Other Car Cost
OtherCarCost.description: The estimated cost of damage to the other vehicle involved in an accident.

states_description.Million: Other car damage cost around $1,000,000 or more.

PropCost.name: Property Cost
PropCost.description: The estimated total property damage cost resulting from an accident.

states_description.Million: Property damage cost around $1,000,000 or more.

RiskAversion.name: Risk Aversion
RiskAversion.description: The driver's general attitude toward risk-taking behavior.

states_description.Psychopath: Extremely reckless with no regard for risk.

RuggedAuto.name: Vehicle Ruggedness
RuggedAuto.description: The structural durability and crash resistance of the vehicle.

states_description.EggShell: Very fragile vehicle structure with poor crash resistance.
states_description.Football: Moderately rugged vehicle with average crash resistance.
states_description.Tank: Extremely rugged vehicle with excellent crash resistance.

SeniorTrain.name: Senior Training
SeniorTrain.description: Whether a senior driver has completed a defensive driving or senior training course.

states_description.True: The senior driver has completed a training course.
states_description.False: The senior driver has not completed a training course.

SocioEcon.name: Socioeconomic Status
SocioEcon.description: The socioeconomic class of the driver.

ThisCarCost.name: This Car Repair Cost
ThisCarCost.description: The estimated cost to repair or replace the insured vehicle after an incident.

ThisCarDam.name: This Car Damage
ThisCarDam.description: The severity of damage to the insured vehicle.

states_description.Severe: Severe damage, potentially totaling the vehicle.

VehicleYear.name: Vehicle Year
VehicleYear.description: Whether the vehicle is a current or older model year.

states_description.Current: The vehicle is a current model year.
states_description.Older: The vehicle is an older model year.
